meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: Decision guide for delegating to caveman-style subagents. Tells the main thread WHEN to spawn `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit), or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of doing the work inline or using vanilla `Explore`. Subagent output is caveman-compressed so the tool-result injected back into main context is ~60% smaller — main context lasts longer across long sessions. Trigger: "delegate to subagent", "use cavecrew", "spawn investigator/builder/reviewer", "save context", "compressed agent output".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分派编码任务给专门子代理,让长会话更持久
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在长AI对话中写代码,希望把子任务交出去以省上下文。
copy.tagline_en: Delegate coding tasks to specialized subagents to make long sessions last
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in long AI conversations and need to delegate subtasks to free up context.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按指南判断何时把任务交给三个专用子代理:找代码、改一两个文件、审查改动。它们用极简压缩格式汇报,占用的上下文更小,长会话能持续更久。
howto.when: 当你说出 'delegate to subagent'、'use cavecrew'、'save context' 等触发词时,Claude 就会按此指南决定是否派子代理以及派哪个。

say.text: 用 cavecrew 找一下 `foo` 在哪个文件定义
say.note: 会派 investigator 返回路径和行号。

say.text: 用 cavecrew-reviewer 检查这个 diff
say.note: 会派 reviewer 审差异,按路径列问题。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude consults the guide to decide when to hand tasks to three subagents: locate code, edit 1-2 files, review changes. They report in terse compressed form, using less context, so long sessions last longer.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you say 'delegate to subagent', 'use cavecrew', 'save context', etc.; Claude then consults the guide to decide whether and which subagent to spawn.

say_en.text: Use cavecrew to find where `foo` is defined
say_en.note: Spawns investigator to return path and line.

say_en.text: Use cavecrew-builder to change line 20 of `app.js` to `bar`
say_en.note: Spawns builder for a small single-file edit.

say_en.text: Use cavecrew-reviewer to check this diff
say_en.note: Spawns reviewer to audit the diff and list issues.
